primaryAction: Elevated welfare strain detected. We recommend connecting with a designated Unit Welfare Officer for proactive support.

actionItems.title: Rest & Sleep Optimization
actionItems.description: Average sleep recorded at 4 hrs/day. Prioritize non-interrupted sleep blocks between duties and practice tactical wind-down protocols.

actionItems.title: Workload & Rest Rotation Consultation
actionItems.description: High weekly duty exposure (66 hrs, 12 consecutive days). Coordinate with unit welfare officer for rest cycle rotation.

actionItems.title: Tactical De-escalation & Mental Reset
actionItems.description: Elevated perceived pressure signals detected. Utilize guided 4-7-8 breathing techniques, brief structured physical decompressions, and peer debriefing.

actionItems.title: Peer & Family Engagement
actionItems.description: Lower social connection indicator noted. Schedule regular check-ins with family, trusted colleagues, or unit peer mentors.

actionItems.title: Downtime Boundary Establishment
actionItems.description: Establish clear separation between operational readiness and personal recuperation time when off-duty.

primaryAction: Maintain current healthy routine and continue regular check-ins.

actionItems.description: Your check-in indicators are balanced. Continue consistent sleep schedules, physical conditioning, and social connectivity.
